spells.name: Purification
spells.effect: Removes any number of Enchantments from the target. Removes Poisoned, Weakened, Petrified, Confused, Blinded States. The target of this Spell cannot be affected by enemy Enchantments until the End phase. If the target has the Undead Trait, it automatically suffers a Wound when hit by this Spell.

spells.name: Greater Cure
spells.effect: Removes Bleeding, Blinded, Confused, Crippled, Petrified, Poisoned, Slowed, Weakened States from allied models within the AoE.

spells.name: Primordial Word
spells.effect: Targetless. During the Resolution Step (after all movements), Summoned, Undead, and models with the Profane or Divine Element affected by the AoE suffer 1 Wound and must be moved into base contact with the outer edge of the AoE. When a model with the Profane or Divine Element enters the AoE or spends an AP within it, that model suffers 1 Wound. Undead and Summoned models cannot enter the AoE. Only one Primordial Word AoE may be on the field per caster. If the caster moves outside the AoE, this spell is removed.
